purpose: Expert-panel coverage behind KOS, not a claim that outside professionals or models are connected or have reviewed a subject.

roleTypes.AI_ROLE: Specialist AI review role; never label as credentialed human
roleTypes.VERIFIED_HUMAN: Human reviewer with independently checked field credentials and conflicts; not presently connected
roleTypes.INSTITUTIONAL_SOURCE: Dated published institutional account, not a human expert opinion

roles.name: Original-source investigator
roles.approach: Checks document identity, provenance, dates, completeness, independent corroboration and conflicting records.

roles.name: Government and institutional governance
roles.approach: Examines jurisdiction, decision authority, boards, agencies, current and historical roles and oversight.

roles.name: Legal systems and rights
roles.approach: Checks legal process, remedies, regulation, civil rights, due process and court/administrative distinctions.

roles.name: Public finance and forensic accounting
roles.approach: Separates proposed, appropriated, contracted, invoiced, paid and delivered outcomes; checks debt and lifecycle cost.

roles.name: Civil, industrial and systems engineering
roles.approach: Evaluates assets, maintenance, tolerances, physical interdependencies and technically feasible alternatives.

roles.name: Water engineering and hydrology
roles.approach: Examines water rights, rivers, treatment, supply, irrigation, wastewater and water-system risks.

roles.name: Energy systems and utilities
roles.approach: Examines generation, distribution, rate regulation, reliability, gas/power networks and household cost effects.

roles.name: Environmental science and ecosystems
roles.approach: Examines air, water, land, wildlife, habitat, contamination and evidence of ecological effects.

roles.name: Healthcare and epidemiology
roles.approach: Examines health-system performance, medical evidence, care accessibility, population health and uncertainty.

roles.name: Education and learning science
roles.approach: Examines schools, educational outcomes, student needs, historical instruction and age-appropriate teaching.

roles.name: Economy, labor and workforce
roles.approach: Examines employers, workers, pay, bargaining, local development, employment outcomes and suppliers.

roles.name: Housing and social services
roles.approach: Examines housing, kinship care, poverty, service availability, families and documented community needs.

roles.name: Agriculture and food systems
roles.approach: Examines production, crops, ranching, irrigation, supply chains and food access.

roles.name: History, archives and culture
roles.approach: Reconstructs chronology and local history with original archives, cultural context and competing interpretations.

roles.name: Information systems and cybersecurity
roles.approach: Examines AI, digital systems, source integrity, privacy, outages and defensive cyber resilience.

roles.name: Emergency planning and continuity
roles.approach: Examines credible cross-system shocks, cascading failures, independent backups and recovery.

roles.name: Community and lived-experience evidence
roles.approach: Identifies documented burdens and benefits without inventing representative voices or speaking for residents.

roles.name: Child safety, disability and inclusion
roles.approach: Examines consequences for children and vulnerable groups, access, rights and protective boundaries.

roles.name: Conflict resolution and practical options
roles.approach: Compares feasible remedies, stakeholder interests, risks, costs, consent and actual decision authority.

roles.name: Skeptic and falsification reviewer
roles.approach: Challenges the leading explanation, seeks disconfirming evidence and checks missing assumptions.

roles.name: Independent alternative-hypothesis reviewer
roles.approach: Develops plausible alternative causal accounts without making them facts or false equivalents.

roles.name: Cross-system consequence reviewer
roles.approach: Follows first-, second- and third-order effects, overlooked populations, money and future liabilities.

roles.name: Plain-language research editor
roles.approach: Checks that a full, accurate story is understandable to a tenth-grade reader without loss of nuance.

standards.minimumDataOutflow: Only an explicitly reviewed public context capsule may be offered to an approved external provider
standards.sourceComparison: Use original issuer/source-version records, not another agent answer as independent corroboration
standards.highConsequence: Independent review, counterexamples, specialist human signoff where necessary; no increase in consequence may reduce review
standards.publication: Human editorial approval and reproducible receipts
